raw_request: 将 AgentTeams 第一阶段收敛为 Local Network MVP；不创建第二个 goal 或 subscription。
understood_objective: Deliver a local AgentTeams MVP: independent daemons launched from ~/.agentteams/config.toml communicate through real local network sockets, discover and broadcast capabilities/resources, negotiate and complete Agent Work without Console forwarding, expose daemon discovery in the UI, and support explicit multi-provider OpenCode configuration with durable readback.
acceptance_criteria: The same ~/.agentteams/config.toml starts at least two independent daemon processes with stable identities, declared capabilities/resources, and owned start/stop/restart lifecycle.

Two daemons communicate over real local network sockets, complete discovery/broadcast/connect/negotiate and Work proposal/request/result/close without Console forwarding, and expose explicit duplicate-request, capacity, restart and stale-generation behavior.

Teams owns multiple provider instances and model catalogs; RCC at 127.0.0.1:4444 and canonical instance goaichat-openai (from the goaichat_openai configuration) are explicit OpenCode provider bindings with catalog/apply/readback and restart persistence; no implicit failover.
The UI reads the authoritative daemon projection and shows identity, presence, capability and resource state; closing the Console does not interrupt Agent Work.

Each delivery unit passes applicable focused/regression gates, exact independent review, integration verification, remote main push, Level 2 memory and owned-resource cleanup; public Relay, NAT/STUN, mobile, direct transport and full UI polish remain later phases.
non_goals: Claim runtime readiness from type declarations or unit tests.
Publish to production without deployment authorization.
Create a second goal or subscription.
Require public Relay, NAT traversal, STUN/ICE, NAT-to-NAT, mobile devices or direct transport in this phase.
Complete master/slave relation governance, browser multi-profile replay or full Console/UI polish in this phase.
Add implicit provider failover, modify upstream providers or disclose credentials.
assumptions: One source admission unit contains existing code; semantic ownership stays in docs/architecture/module-registry.json.
Console is optional and never an Agent-to-Agent transport; passive capability Agents and one-to-many resource semantics remain first-class.
A local Relay/bridge process may assist local discovery and connection, but Agent Work data must remain on the Agent-to-Agent path and the Console is not a relay.
RCC 4444 is the primary provider and canonical goaichat-openai is an explicit backup instance sourced from goaichat_openai; selection and errors remain visible.
Existing mapped source regression gates remain applicable when their owned paths are affected; public/NAT and device live acceptance are later phases.
